subject: 松本城 · 大天守与连结天守群
name: 松本城天守
yearNote: 文化厅数据库将松本城天守归「城郭建筑／江户」，年代记「江户前期／1615頃」；其解说文（引《国宝辞典》）称现存天守为石川康长文禄三年至庆长四年（1594–1599）造营，宽永年间（1624–44）增建辰巳附橹、月见橹；2025年松本市年轮年代调查得大天守部分柱材伐于1596年。本条按文化厅分类归江户、年表点取约1615，并保留异说。1936年列旧国宝，1952年3月29日依文化财保护法指定国宝（天守、乾小天守、渡橹、辰巳附橹、月见橹五栋）。
place: 日本 · 长野县 · 松本
coordinate_source: ja.wikipedia GeoData（松本城）坐标 36.2391, 137.969119，作为松本显示点，非天守测绘坐标。
lede: 松本城大天守五重六阶，黑漆下见板与白灰上壁一层层交替，立在内堀之上。乾小天守以渡橹相连，宽永年间又增建辰巳附橹和月见橹，五栋合为一组连结复合式天守，1952年同列国宝。文化厅记现天守建于江户前期约1615年，传统说法则为石川康长1594至1599年营造。
facts: 大天守五重六阶，本瓦葺，与乾小天守、渡橹、辰巳附橹、月见橹五栋同为国宝；1936年列旧国宝，1952年依新法指定。
文化厅数据库记江户前期约1615年；《国宝辞典》称石川康长文禄三年至庆长四年（1594–1599）造营；2025年年轮测定得柱材伐于1596年。
外壁自初重至最上重皆黑涂下见板，屋顶设唐破风与千鸟破风；平城天守而规模居现存前列，1950至55年解体修理。
caption: 松本城 · 大天守与连结天守群
江户前期 · 约1615年（另说1594–1599）
structure_checkpoints: 大天守自外观数恰五层屋檐（五重六阶）；每层下半为黑色下见板、上半为白灰壁，线稿只勾分界，不作黑色填充；本瓦葺灰瓦，顶层入母屋带鯱。
南面第三重设三角形千鸟破风，另有唐破风（照片2可见于西面第四重位置），按照片位置绘制。
左侧乾小天守三重，以渡橹与大天守相连；右侧辰巳附橹二重、月见橹一重带朱漆回缘高栏。
全群立于坡度平缓的石垣上，石垣下为内堀水面；照片2右侧月见橹处的修缮脚手架去除；只保留一条短水面线，不画倒影。
material_observations: 黑漆下见板、白灰壁，灰色本瓦，青灰石垣，月见橹朱漆高栏，鯱为金铜色；水面、云、山与树去除。
author: Hiroaki Kikuchi

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

Matsumoto Castle keep group, Nagano, early 17th century. Use photo 2 (from the south-west across the moat, the only view showing all five linked structures) for the composition and photo 3 (straight south view) for the main keep's proportions. Draw the complete linked keep: the MAIN KEEP with EXACTLY FIVE roof tiers (five storeys visible outside), each storey showing dark boarding on the lower half and plaster on the upper half, drawn as outlines only with no black fill; a triangular chidori-hafu gable on the third tier of the south face and a curved karahafu as photographed; the three-tier small keep (Inui) linked at the left by a roofed passage; the two-tier Tatsumi turret and the one-tier Moon-viewing turret with an open balcony railing at the right; all on a sloping stone wall rising from the water. Remove the repair scaffolding at the right turret, trees, mountains, clouds and the reflection; one short water line only.
